title: Advanced HTML: semantics
explanation: Use nav for major navigation, main for the primary content, and article for a self-contained item. A section normally has a heading. A div is useful when no semantic element fits.
Use lists for groups of items, tables for tabular data, and forms for collecting input. Table headers identify rows or columns; a caption names the table. Do not use tables to position page sections.
An input needs a visible label connected through for and id, or by nesting. A placeholder disappears and is not a replacement for the label.

quiz.question: What gives an input a persistent accessible name?
quiz.explanation: A connected label identifies the control even when it contains text.
